name: Consummation 1
description: Expends all stacks in a single blow.  Deals more damage based on the amount of stacks used, your current stance, and will return you back to 1.  Remains in stance after use.  Scales off your maximum health. Fire: Explodes Burn effect for extra damage; Earth: Beag Suain (more damage the more the mobs are tightly packed on you); Water: Restores mana; Lightning: Attacks every tile adjacent (more damage if there's empty space behind targets).

name: Culmination 1
description: Expends all stacks in a single blow.  Deals more damage based on the amount of stacks used, your current stance, and will return you back to 1.  Remains in stance after use.  Scales off your maximum health. Fire: Explodes Burn effect for extra damage; Earth: Beag Suain (more damage the more the mobs are tightly packed on you); Water: Restores mana; Lightning: Attacks every tile adjacent (more damage if there's empty space behind targets).  Pure Only.

name: Drakestrike 1
description: Strikes up to 4 tiles in front of you, using the element of your necklace.  Scales with your maximum health.

name: Flowing Fist 1
description: Adept's assail that changes based on stance; Fire: Directly in front; Earth: Front and sides; Water: Front and Sides returning mana on each blow; Lightning: Attacks on all 4 sides; Neutral: normal assail to front and sides.  Scales with your maximum health.

name: Focused Strike 1
description: Single strike that changes based on stance; Fire: Sets the target on fire; Earth: Casts Beag Suain; Water: Restores mana; Lightning: Exposes the enemy to take 30% more damage from the next skill or spell.  Also scales with your maximum health.

name: Rising Kick 1
description: The heaviest blow that changes based on your stance; Fire: Explodes Burn effect for extra damage; Earth: Beag Suain (more damage the more the mobs are tightly packed on you); Water: Restores mana; Lightning: Attacks every tile adjacent (more damage if there's empty space behind targets).  Scales with your maximum health.

name: Severed Breath
description: Spends 2/3 of your current health to strike every enemy directly in front of you for 1/3 of it (Wont be reduced by armour, aite, etc and reflect wont return).  Skill damage bonuses do not affect the damage.

name: Sweeping Palm 1
description: Sweeps the enemies adjacent to you, shifting with your stance; Fire: Strikes all enemies adjacent setting them on fire, Earth: Strikes all enemies adjacent; Water: Strikes all enemies adjacent and restores mana; Lightning: Reaches further, and deals more with open space around targets.  Scales with your maximum health.

name: Upheaval 1
description: Position your targets, that changes when you shift your stance; Fire/Earth: Pulls enemies in towards you; Water: Pulls enemies in towards you and restores mana; Lightning: Shoves them off of you.  Scales with your maximum health.

name: Waning Moon 1
description: Deals massive non-elemental damage to the enemy directly in front of you.  Scales with your CON and maximum health.

name: Wyrmstrike 1
description: Strike enemies in a cone up to 5 tiles in front of you dealing the element of your necklace.  Scales with your maximum health.  Pure Only.
